about: The Japanese Cutling TikTok posts (card ASG221), each with its time; words come from copy-ja.json. Nothing is scheduled before the owner's go on the review page; the Dec 1-3 films also wait for Cutling 2.0 READY_FOR_SALE.
why: On @monholt, the one Japanese-language post (the Cutling bank-number film, Nov 18) drew 27.7% Japanese viewers, all from For You. No English or Indonesian post drew more than 1.2%. Japanese viewers come for Japanese words.
account: @monholt, not a new Japanese account: the Japanese post found Japan there with one follower, and a new account starts from nothing. Opening @monholtjapan later needs your yes.
elevenlabs: The voice alone did not pull Japan: the English and Indonesian ElevenLabs films drew none. The one post that did spoke Japanese through ElevenLabs, so every film here keeps the same Japanese voice.
go: Each film goes on TikTok Studio at its time, marked Your brand like the English ones, and is logged in social-posts.md.

posts.name: Type it once
posts.why: The Japanese cut of the Cutling film posted on Nov 25. The address is typed as a Japanese iPhone does it: underlined hiragana, iOS's own guesses in the bar (東京鳥栖, 公園, 高円寺味), then one tap turns the row into kanji. The address and guesses come from a real run of iOS 27.2's Japanese keyboard.

posts.name: What's new in 2.0
posts.why: The 2.0 release film, recorded again on the real 2.0 build in Japanese, with Japanese lines and voice. The date beat types 11月25日, the day it was recorded. The first beat comes from an earlier half-size recording, so it is a little softer than the rest.
posts.gate: Goes out only once Cutling 2.0 is on the App Store.
